title: Chapter 431 Conditions For Peace
content:
Chapter 431 Conditions For Peace

Noen led the way personally, so naturally no blind demon tribe would bother them.

Moreover, the aura of the high-level warriors also made ordinary demon tribes dare not act rashly.

When they reached the foot of the mountain where the Demon King's palace was located, Wang Shuo directly showed his original cultivation.

After all, it was still a bit consuming to use skills all the time.

Noen saw Wang Shuo's aura change and was puzzled, but he didn't say anything.

He took Wang Shuo to a hall in the belly of the mountain, and Noen asked Wang Shuo and the other two to wait here.

Wang Shuo looked at the hall carefully. On the steps of more than ten steps, there was a huge stone chair, which was more than ten meters wide.

The whole hall was also very huge, and it should be able to accommodate several huge demon beasts.

Wang Shuo was thinking, do these guys usually appear here in their original bodies when they hold meetings?

Just when Wang Shuo was daydreaming, the place where the Demon King was in seclusion.

"Your Majesty, the Demon King, Wang Shuo from the Great Locust Domain is here."

"Uh, someone is here, and he is one of the three giants in the Great Locust Domain?"

The Demon King Maris also widened his eyes, not believing his ears.

"Isn't he afraid that I will swallow him in one bite? Ah! Hahaha!"

The Demon King was also interested!

He originally thought that a small human was not qualified to waste his time, but since he met such an interesting person, it would be okay to meet him.

He moved his body and turned into his original form, a pterosaur with a wingspan of more than 50 meters, flying towards the throne.

Wang Shuo felt the huge movement from behind and became alert.

Suddenly, a brown pterosaur flew over his head at a low altitude, and he almost couldn't help but want to attack.

But such a strong sense of crisis, I am afraid, only the Demon King has it!

Gong Zheng and Ye Tianba behind him had already grasped their weapons tightly, ready to attack at any time.

Wang Shuo looked calm, but he was still panicking. He kept reminding himself that this time, he was here to negotiate, not to challenge the Demon King.

The Demon King circled again and flew back to the throne.

Just now, he just wanted to test how brave this person who dared to enter the Demon King's Court was.

"Yes, you are Wang Shuo, right? I heard that you killed a patriarch of my demon clan and millions of people."

The Demon King said this without anger, as if he had killed some unimportant characters.

"It is inevitable that there will be some damage when both sides fight." Wang Shuo did not deny the fact that he killed the crocodile leader.

In the mind of the Demon King, as long as they have not reached the Star Glory level, that is, high-level generals, they are all chess pieces that can be abandoned at any time, even the Star Glory level subordinates, as long as the chips are enough, they can also be exchanged.

Even he himself is a chess piece of others.

"Yes, so, are you planning to join me this time?"

Wang Shuo immediately said: "Your Majesty the Demon King, you are joking. I am not coming here to join the demon clan this time, but just want to form an alliance with the demon clan. After all, we in the Great Huai Domain are not warlike and hope for peace."

Maris did not believe Wang Shuo's excuse at all.

Humans are more warlike than demon beasts. As long as they have the opportunity, they will start a war.

Over the years, he has witnessed too much.

"I like peace too, hahaha!"

"But peace needs to be protected by strength. Wang Shuo, I want to see if you have the ability to protect the Great Huai Domain."

Faced with the provocation of the Demon King, Wang Shuo became alert!

"You know, not everyone is qualified to negotiate with me."

"If you beat Norn, you can get peace."
